newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-NEW TOUR COMMISSIONER NAMED.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-NEW TOUR COMMISSIONER NAMED.

text.p: Former career diplomat Arnold Mentz was named as the new commissioner of the Professional Golf Tour of South Africa on Friday.

The 49-year-old South African, who has been professional at Southbroom Golf Club on the Natal south coast fro the past five years, succeeds Brent Chalmers who resigned at the tour's annual meeting earlier this month.

Mentz spent 20 years in the civil service as public relations officer for the trade and industry minister and then as economics officer at the Washington embassy. He also worked in Turkey and South America before his passion for golf took over.
He takes over from Chalmers on December 1.
